title: Gairvis
description: A discontinued AI assistant that reached 10 users and evolved into an open-source, local-first Wispr Flow alternative.
body:
Gairvis reached 10 users and provided a useful foundation for the next product direction. The original standalone product has been discontinued.

## Outcome: open source and local-first

The work was made open source and continued as a Wispr Flow alternative with a local LLM option. The decision was to focus on a less expensive, better-fitting local tool rather than keep competing with another standalone product in an intensely competitive market.

The continuation is [Wispr Alternative Local LLM](/projects/wispr-alternatve-local-llm), a macOS tool for local dictation, configurable LLM commands, and agent handoff.

## What remains

Gairvis is preserved here as part of the build history, not as an actively developed commercial product. The learning and development effort continue in the open-source successor.
